summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the new Analysis tab feature. All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all components: CAS PDF upload form, Scheme Master section (broker only), Analysis History with view/download/delete actions, and navigation from sidebar. The feature correctly extracts 77 folios and 1357 transactions from CAS PDF and generates Gap Sheet Excel reports.
